critical_code_review_comments: admin_data_audit.py cleanup/execute is intentionally serialized per-user (no parallel _del) — good for consistency; average cleanup for the 1-badge account took <1s in this run. Larger accounts (many R2 media) still risk approaching gateway timeout as noted in handoff. Consider adding an async job queue in a future iteration if bulk cleanup is planned.

cleanup/execute audit row shape returned by the API is enriched (results[] contain deleted counts); GET /cleanup/audit returns full docs — Mongo _id is stripped correctly via projection {_id: 0}. Good.

auth register enforces TOS on 400 — but the review request testing plan did not mention TOS gating (accepted_terms/privacy/conditions/age_confirmed_13 required). This is not a bug, but future automation-only signup callers must know to include those four flags or they will hit the terms-acceptance 400 (currently returned as 400, not 422). Consider raising 422 here since it's user-input validation.

AdminDataHealth.jsx synthetic scan table cleanly disables checkboxes on non-confirmed_synthetic rows (verified — stealth row has no dh-select-stealth). Good UX guard against accidental deletion of system/real accounts.
Signup friendly error surfaces exactly the intended text; add HTTP status to error banner as tiny debug affordance in dev builds is a nice-to-have but not required.
DJ Realm page briefly shows 'Loading realm…' skeleton; consider adding a data-testid to that skeleton so tests can detect finish state deterministically.
